selection: Driver preserves its original full-frame exact selector for reproducibility. Report intent accuracy of every fixed component separately; do not select a full parser or promote M1 based on this component.
hypothesis: Isolating intent removes interference from many token updates while using the existing encoder/codec, without extra input labels or a new pretrained model. Subsequent integration with a separately trained segmenter is not yet delivered by this protocol.
labels: Every train BIO label becomes O only for this component; original intent and text are unchanged. Development truth and all full M1 checks stay original. An intent-only response cannot be called a correctly parsed slot-bearing request.
scope: Component study on consumed development, not free language, whole parser success, a new reserve or full M1. Same page/genome/work caps. No test/reserved-worker text or labels used.
